A_ground_truth_provenance.details: Within the supplied artifact boundary, the evaluator loads 245 dataset init.txt files independently of tracker predictions. All declared source-path hashes/sizes match. No noninitial prediction row exactly equals its GT row; no GT file equals a prediction file. First-frame GT initialization is explicit and expected. These observations reject a direct prediction-copy proxy in this bundle; they do not authenticate the original official distribution or prove the full absent runtime dependency graph.

evidence.supports: LasHeR GT is loaded directly from dataset init.txt
Only the first annotation line initializes inference
Subsequent steps receive images/frame/state rather than GT
First dataset GT file provenance record

B_score_normalization_and_protocol.details: No score is normalized by model-output statistics. NPR normalizes each center coordinate using GT width/height plus 1e-8. The supplied installed toolkit is reproduced exactly, including float32 integer rounding, GT first-frame replacement, NPR-before-PR/SR, threshold inequalities, equal sequence weighting, and the invalid-GT sentinel behavior. Upstream official-version authenticity is unavailable, so this is a supplied-toolkit reproduction rather than an independently authenticated canonical protocol certification.

evidence.supports: Float32 text loader output is rounded to integer coordinates
NPR thresholds, first-frame and invalid-GT handling

C_result_existence_numbers_and_lineage.details: The completed LasHeR report, both shard receipts, all 245 prediction files and all 245 latency arrays exist and reconcile to 220703 frames / 220458 measured tracking calls. All standard scores, mean curves, per-sequence JSON/CSV scores, attribute scores and latency values match exactly. The timing concurrency description is incorrect for this relay. Selected epoch10 and checkpoint path/hash metadata agree across snapshots; the checkpoint bytes, original inference process receipts/logs and complete runtime provenance are not present for independent attestation.

evidence.supports: Completed LasHeR report, epoch and inventory
Selected checkpoint path and recorded SHA256

D_called_vs_dead_metrics.details: The scoring entry point calls NPR, PR and SR via getattr; LasHeR binds them to NPR, PR_LasHeR and SR_LasHeR. All outputs materialize in the report, CSV and reconstructed curves. summarize_lasher is called and has a result artifact. MPR/MSR, generic PR/SR and GTOT variants are other dataset branches and are not misrepresented as LasHeR results. Training cached_validation is called by training and explicitly labels its scores diagnostic. No claimed standard metric depends on uncalled code. Missing raw mechanism traces prevent full revalidation of mechanism outputs, not proof of dead code.

evidence.supports: Mechanism summary is called and written
Cached utility scores explicitly exclude formal metrics

E_scope_and_claim_ceiling.details: This bundle proves one selected search_actions epoch10 LasHeR evaluation across 245 sequences, with one recorded training seed42. It does not prove the full three-benchmark result, matched cost improvement, independently effective A/B/C mechanisms, or cross-seed robustness. One best seed is allowed by the current plan; extra successful seeds are not imposed here. PR and NPR are below the user-provided reference, SR is only +0.0419915 pp, and none of the +6 pp targets is met. Snapshots that still say formal_metrics_complete=false refer to prior stages or to completion of all three datasets; the completed LasHeR artifact is not thereby contradicted.

evidence.supports: One best seed allowed; three successful seeds not required
RGBT234 jobs still running at observation
Global formal completion only after all three datasets

F_evaluation_type.details: Standard tracking metrics use dataset annotations. Mechanism error/write diagnostics are explicitly GT-assisted localization proxies, not semantic identity ground truth or causal future evidence. They are not model-generated substitute GT. The full pipeline is not classified as synthetic_proxy or simulation_only.

evidence.supports: Immediate harms are not a causal future comparison

issues.title: Timing report incorrectly says concurrent two-GPU run
issues.finding: The report/score.py static string says concurrent two-GPU run. The supplied formal relay launches both inference shards with gpu=2; the handoff identifies both LasHeR processes on GPU2. A second GPU may run a different control task, but this is not two-GPU distribution of the audited tracker run.
issues.impact: Numeric latency/FPS arithmetic remains correct. The hardware concurrency label must not be used as evidence of two-GPU throughput or matched baseline speedup.
issues.recommended_correction: In a derived corrected report or future report metadata, describe two concurrent inference workers on physical GPU2, with shared-host concurrent workload; preserve this sealed original input. Keep FPS explicitly as reciprocal pooled worker-frame latency, not wall-clock throughput.

evidence.supports: Both LasHeR NN process IDs stated on GPU2

limitations.check: Full runtime code provenance and no-later-GT causality
limitations.details: The actual inference entry point reads only first-frame GT, and supplied runtime functions accept causal state/image inputs. The 14-file relay seal omits active search_actions.py, ported_modules.py and mechanism_summary.py; counterfactual.py and vendor CADTrack sources are not in this bundle, and no actual launch-time source-digest map is supplied. Collection-time hashes must not be described as a complete immutable run-code attestation.

No *_mechanisms.json traces are supplied. Candidate recall/newly recalled acceptance, immediate keep-vs-chosen rescues/harms, alternative selections and geometry/template/memory commits cannot be reconstructed from final predictions alone. Their reported ratios and extra-forward receipt sums are internally consistent but not independently validated behavior. Final-output IoU, valid/failure counts and all 881 recovery events ARE recomputed exactly.

limitations.check: Matched baseline/system-cost or wall-clock speed claim
limitations.details: 245 arrays provide 220458 synchronized per-step intervals and all arithmetic is exact. The interval includes decoding, crops, network/decision/state updates; it excludes initialization, model loading, final output CPU extraction after the timer, diagnostics extraction and serialization. Sum of worker times is not elapsed concurrent-run time, and no matched baseline timing or raw baseline predictions are supplied.

evidence.supports: User reference only; no paired baseline

protocol.reference: Supplied installed /data/wangwj/RGBT_toolkit-master/src snapshot; upstream official release not authenticated
protocol.ground_truth_dtype_and_load: float64 np.loadtxt(dataset/init.txt, delimiter=comma, ndmin=2), replacing constructor GT
protocol.prediction_serialization: infer writes tab-delimited xywh at 3 decimal places
protocol.prediction_loader: float32 load_text then NumPy round(0), then list of row arrays
protocol.initialization: Only first GT box initializes inference; every metric replaces loaded first prediction with GT[0] and retains that frame in the denominator
protocol.invalid_prediction: Nonpositive width/height after rounding carries forward previous prediction; observed affected frames=0
protocol.PR: Center Euclidean error <= integer thresholds 0..50; index20 = 20 pixels
protocol.NPR: Center coordinates divided componentwise by GT width/height+1e-8; Euclidean error <= thresholds 0..0.5 step0.01; index20 = 0.20
protocol.SR: Inclusive ltwh-to-ltrb IoU; strict IoU > thresholds 0..1 step0.05; arithmetic mean of all21 curve samples, not trapezoidal AUC or plain mean IoU
protocol.invalid_ground_truth: Any one of x,y,w,h <=0 sets error/IoU to -1. This counts as precision/NPR success at every nonnegative threshold and SR failure; frame remains in denominator.
protocol.credit_interpretation: Contribution to the reported PR/NPR numerators with original denominators, not a replacement score or bias estimate against a different missing-data protocol
protocol.aggregation: Equal weight per sequence, regardless of frame count; same equal weighting within each exported attribute membership list

deterministic_verification.method: CPU Python3.12.6/NumPy1.26.4; actual metric/loader bodies replayed in memory with imports separated, plus independent NumPy formula; original CLI and neural model not executed
